row:
Atlas Brain and Spine is a NUCCA (National Upper Cervical Chiropractic Association) Chiropractic office located in Upland Ca. We have been providing the highest quality of care, for over 15 years, while still allowing for the best experience an individual has had in a doctor's office. 

We specialize in the upper neck, specifically the first bone of the neck called Atlas, and how the alignment of the Atlas will effect the central nervous system. We take precise x-rays to develop a 3-demensional model of your Atlas to calculate the vector that is tailored to you. The correction is gentile and precise with no popping or cracking. 

To schedule a consultation with one of our doctors please call 909-982-9100.
To learn more about our practice visit our website: atlasbrainspine.com

We would love to see if our gentle and proven approach is right for you.

When you restore your brain, you will heal your pain.
